subject: Air freight quote to DFW – fastest option
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option to DFW (Dallas, US)? The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-28 at our site in postcode 53345 (Bonn), Germany. Please arrange the truck from our site to the departure airport and include it in your all-in price in EUR.

The shipment consists of 5 pieces of automotive sensors, with a gross weight of 65 kg and a total volume of 0.37 cbm. Please let me know the earliest possible arrival at DFW.

Please attach your offer as a PDF to your reply, as our purchasing department needs it for filing.

Thank you.

Viele Gruesse / Many greetings
Deniz Yilmaz
Rheintal Elektronik GmbH
